resources.string: Adds a Linguize button for apps like Telegram where Linguize isn\'t in the selection menu. When you tap the button, Linguize reads the text field you\'re typing in, at that moment only, and sends the text to the AI service you set up (Gemini or OpenAI) to check it. Nothing goes back into the field unless you accept it. If History is on, checks are saved on this phone. Linguize skips fields that look like passwords, codes, numbers or email addresses.
